elaine: quick UX question — for the new Model Settings form: should we use explicit 'Required' copy on labels or stick with an asterisk + tooltip? also worried about the bulk delete flow — per-row errors vs global fallback? josh: i'd vote for the full word 'Required' for accessibility. asterisk alone needs extra SR-only markup to be read correctly. aria: agreed. if we keep the asterisk we must add an sr-only '(required)'. e.g. `Label (required)` for screen readers. zane: tradeoff though — 'Required' clutters dense tables. could we show the full label only for the first instance in a section and a compact asterisk after? maria: for delete flows, current modal has checkbox confirm. accessibility nits: ensure focus trap, ESC closes, and success message is announced (role=alert). also primary action copy matters — not just 'Confirm'. josh: inline errors vs top summary — i think inline is better for realtime validation, but on submit for long forms a sticky summary that links to fields is helpful. elaine: proposal: use inline field-level errors for immediate feedback + a dismissible sticky summary at top after submit that links to the first errored field. that covers both keyboard and sighted flows. aria: implementation notes: set `aria-invalid="true"` on the input, `aria-describedby` to the inline message id. for the summary use `
` and programmatically move focus to it after a failed submit. zane: copy for destructive actions: avoid vague 'Are you sure?'. impact-first copy is clearer: e.g., 'Delete 12 recordings — this cannot be undone' and list examples if space allows. maria: :thumbsup: i'll make two comps — one with 'Required' labels and one with asterisks + sr-only text, and a destructive modal variant with improved copy. can we do a quick review tomorrow 11am? elaine: added to calendar. tagging @design-ops for an accessibility pass. deploy-bot: Prototype preview deployed: https://redwood.preview/proto-223 (build 1865432120).
